title: SLB holding upload (BOW front end, SLB_HOLDING_UPLOAD)
purpose: Each client's securities lending and borrowing (SLB) holding by ISIN, pipe-separated. Ledgerline does not keep SLB positions, so the file is written empty with a note. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.
